claims.text: The dataset consists of more than 70,000 US English phone conversations, each averaging 11 minutes in duration.
The conversations cover various domains, including account inquiries, refund requests, and service cancellations.
A sample of 500 rescored intent annotations was taken from the cancellations and refunds domain for evaluation.
